instrument: Signal analyzer (Rohde & Schwarz FSQ3 / FSQ8 / FSQ26 / FSQ39 / FSQ40)
source: Transcribed from the R&S FSQ Signal Analyzer Operating Manual (1313.9681.12-02, covering the FSQ3 through FSQ40, 1313.9100Kxx), chapter 6 Remote Control - Description of Commands, served by R&S's own CDN. The FSU's generation and the FSU's layout: column-0 headings carrying plain-word parameter clauses, Example / Characteristics / Mode labels, and prose-stated query exceptions, all of which the parser reads. The IEEE 488.2 entries are curated rather than extracted, exactly as the FSU's are: the common-commands section describes the set in prose the extraction mangles, inventing query forms for *CLS, *RST, *TRG and *WAI.

guide.title: R&S FSQ Signal Analyzer Operating Manual

supplements.description: Initiates a calibration of the instrument and subsequently queries the calibration status. Responses greater than 0 indicate errors.
Returns the contents of the IST flag in decimal form. The IST flag is the status bit which is sent during a parallel poll.
Indicates the controller address to which remote control is returned after termination of the triggered action. Range 0 to 30.
Sets the parallel poll enable register to the indicated value. Range 0 to 255.
Returns the contents of the parallel poll enable register in decimal form.
